QuestInfo.name: Headmaster Ferdi
QuestInfo.0: #p2151003# who told you about to Resistance has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151003# introduced you to #b#p2151010##k, a Basic Training instructor in #b#m310010010##k. Claudine said you can restore your weakened body by taking the basic training course, so go see #p2151010#.
QuestInfo.2: #p2151010# gave you warm a welcome when you said that you came to get basic training.

0.0: Don't you feel free now, #h0#? You were in the ground for so long. Anyway, I have something for you to do. Are you free now?

yes.0: There's a training instructor named #p2151010# in Resistance. Since your body has weakened, maybe you should check out his training courses. Might do you some good! #b#p2151010##k is in #b#m310010010##k.

no.0: Well, all right. Just come back when you have time.

1.0: Hello. Did you come here for me?

yes.0: Ah, you're here for training. Welcome. We can work on getting some of your combat reflexes back with basic training. Despite the name, it's not exactly easy, so get ready.
